settings.name: Overlap buffer distance (m)
settings.description: Distance in meters around each turbine/solar array used to define spatial 'overlap' with the tracking data. Typical displacement-study values range from a few hundred meters to a few kilometers depending on taxon.

settings.name: Check wind turbine overlap
settings.description: Whether to check the tracking data against the USGS/LBNL/ACP U.S. Wind Turbine Database (USWTDB).

settings.name: Check solar array overlap
settings.description: Whether to check the tracking data against the Ground-Mounted Solar Energy in the United States (GM-SEUS) dataset.

settings.name: Infrastructure query region
settings.description: How to define the search region used to fetch candidate infrastructure. 'bbox' uses one buffered bounding box for the whole dataset (simple, but can be very large/wasteful for wide-ranging or migratory tracks). 'trajectory' queries with one buffered bounding box per track instead, merging results -- tighter for wide-ranging or migratory data, at the cost of more API calls.

options.displayText: Single bounding box for the whole study

settings.name: Thin locations for overlap test on very large tracks
settings.description: For extremely high-frequency/long-duration tracks, optionally subsample locations before the infrastructure overlap test (quality metrics always use the full, unthinned track regardless of this setting). Off by default, since thinning trades a small chance of missing a brief close pass between two fixes for speed.

settings.name: Max locations per track for overlap test (if thinning enabled)
settings.description: When thinning is enabled, tracks with more locations than this are evenly subsampled down to approximately this many points before the overlap test.

settings.name: Analyze location height relative to infrastructure
settings.description: If the input data includes a recognized Movebank height field (height_above_ground_level, height_above_mean_sea_level, or height_above_ellipsoid), reports the height of locations near turbines and solar arrays. Only height_above_ground_level (true height above ground) enables the wind rotor-swept-zone pass/fail classification and the solar at/below-assumed-panel-height comparison; the other fields are reported as informational context only (raw min/median/max height), since they cannot be safely compared to a ground-relative reference without a ground-elevation correction this App does not perform.

settings.name: Assumed solar panel height (m)
settings.description: Only used when height analysis (above) is on, height_above_ground_level is available, and solar overlap checking is on. GM-SEUS has no per-array height field to look up (unlike USWTDB's per-turbine hub height), so this single assumed height is compared against every buffer-zone fix's height instead, to report whether animals near an array were flying close to panel level or well above it. Not a hazard pass/fail classification the way the wind rotor zone is -- ground-mounted panels aren't a rotating strike hazard. Utility-scale ground-mounted arrays commonly range roughly 2-4 m depending on fixed-tilt vs. tracker design; override this if a more accurate value is known for the array types/region in this study.

settings.name: Data quality scorecard: minimum locations (optional)
settings.description: Optional. Draws a dashed reference line at this value on the PDF report's data quality scorecard chart, for the 'N locations' metric. Purely a visual reference -- the App never excludes or flags tracks based on this value, since what counts as 'enough' data depends on the taxon and research question (see the Data quality summary table, which is unaffected either way). Leave unset for no reference line.

settings.name: Data quality scorecard: minimum duration, days (optional)
settings.description: Optional. Draws a dashed reference line at this value on the PDF report's data quality scorecard chart, for the 'Duration (days)' metric. Purely a visual reference -- the App never excludes or flags tracks based on this value (see min_locations above for why). Leave unset for no reference line.

settings.name: Data quality scorecard: maximum median fix interval, hours (optional)
settings.description: Optional. Draws a dashed reference line at this value on the PDF report's data quality scorecard chart, for the 'Median fix interval (h)' metric. Purely a visual reference -- the App never excludes or flags tracks based on this value (see min_locations above for why). Leave unset for no reference line.
